# CMS Requirements Quality Checklist

**Purpose**: Validate CMS requirements for completeness, clarity, consistency, and enforcement of cross-epic dependencies prior to merge.
**Created**: 2025-11-02
**Feature**: specs/002-cms/spec.md

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are create/edit/publish/unpublish requirements enumerated for articles, banners, and themes individually rather than implied collectively? [Completeness, Spec §Functional Requirements > FR-CMS-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the spec define audit trail entry content, retention, and visibility to satisfy workflow audit expectations? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §Functional Requirements > FR-CMS-004, Data Model §Entities]
- [ ] CHK003 Are role-based enforcement points for each CMS endpoint explicitly tied to 009-auth-profile requirements? [Completeness, Spec §Related Specs, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK004 Are theme configuration requirements (fields, constraints, asset handling) documented to match the stated CMS workflow scope? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §Key Entities > Theme, Research §Open Questions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the ≤5 minute propagation SLA stated directly in this spec rather than only via umbrella reference? [Clarity, Spec §Functional Requirements > FR-CMS-002, Research §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK006 Are preview roles enumerated with the exact permissions needed for draft/review/preview interactions? [Clarity, Spec §Functional Requirements > FR-CMS-003, Research §Decisions]
- [ ] CHK007 Are banner ordering and prioritization rules expressed with deterministic tie-breakers and default values? [Clarity, Data Model §Validation & Constraints]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Do workflow states and transition rules align between spec, data model, and plan (no mismatched enums or steps)? [Consistency, Spec §Functional Requirements > FR-CMS-004, Data Model §State Transitions, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK009 Are preview access assumptions consistent between quickstart examples and the temporary header strategy? [Consistency, Quickstart §Try it, Research §Decisions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Do acceptance scenarios include measurable outcomes for banners and themes alongside articles? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK011 Are propagation timing expectations tied to observable start/end triggers that can be validated objectively? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK012 Are exception scenarios documented for failed workflow approvals, invalid schedules, or permission denials? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK013 Are zero-content states and unpublished theme previews described so behavior is defined when datasets are empty? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §User Scenarios]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Do overlapping banner rules specify how equal publishAt timestamps are resolved beyond order weighting? [Edge Case, Data Model §Validation & Constraints]
- [ ] CHK015 Is timezone handling detailed for locale display (including daylight saving) in addition to UTC storage? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK016 Are monitoring and alerting expectations for the ≤5 minute propagation SLA documented as requirements? [Non-Functional, Gap, Research §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK017 Are performance targets for CMS endpoints (e.g., P95 ≤ 500ms) captured in the requirements rather than only in task notes? [Non-Functional, Tasks §T022]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the requirement for clock synchronization (to mitigate schedule skew) formally recorded? [Non-Functional, Research §Risks]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK019 Is the temporary header-based preview role assumption marked with follow-up criteria for integrating the 009-auth-profile delivery? [Dependencies, Research §Decisions]
- [ ] CHK020 Are persistence choices (in-memory vs Postgres) accompanied by requirements for migration triggers and parity expectations? [Dependencies, Quickstart §Use Postgres for CMS, Research §Open Questions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK021 Is the mapping from the Default Policy Table to CMS workflow states and permissions unambiguous to avoid conflicting definitions? [Ambiguity, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios, Spec §Related Specs]
- [ ] CHK022 Are ownership boundaries between the CMS spec and umbrella auth policies documented to prevent overlapping or conflicting requirements? [Conflict, Spec §Related Specs, Plan §Technical Context]
